report_sections.evidence: Introduction. Clearly define the real-world problem the group aims to address. Explain its real-world significance and impact, identify key challenges and constraints, clearly state project objectives and scope, and explain the benefits of an effective solution. Theoretical Justifications. Provide a detailed explanation of the proposed AI-based method. Justify why the methods are appropriate for the problem and support the argument with relevant academic literature. Workflow and Empirical Analysis. Describe the workflow of the developed solution, including key steps such as data preprocessing, algorithmic approach, and implementation details. Explain model design, algorithmic choices, and integration of multiple AI paradigms. Clearly distinguish design decisions from implementation details. Present experimental results using either real-world datasets sourced online or synthetic data created by the group. Include empirical analysis that demonstrates the effectiveness of the solution. Describe the experimental setup, use appropriate evaluation metrics, present results clearly using tables or figures, and provide a link to a publicly accessible GitHub repository containing the full code implementation. The report should focus on describing the workflow rather than including raw code. Critical Reflection. Critically evaluate limitations and failure cases of the approach, trade-offs such as optimality versus efficiency or accuracy versus interpretability, scalability, and computational constraints, and when alternative approaches may be more suitable. Additional Expectations. Use academic references where appropriate, demonstrate critical thinking rather than just implementation, clearly distinguish design choices from results, and avoid focusing solely on software engineering. Emphasise AI reasoning and evaluation.

value.title: Executive Summary and Introduction
value.hd_requirement: Comprehensive and concise executive summary capturing objectives, AI approach, and key findings. Clearly defines a real-world problem with strong significance, well-structured context, challenges, scope, and impact. Demonstrates clear linkage between the problem and AI-based solution, with awareness of ethical and real-world implications.

value.title: Theoretical Justification
value.hd_requirement: Provides a rigorous, well-structured explanation of AI methods with strong theoretical foundations such as search, probabilistic reasoning, multi-layer networks, reinforcement learning, GenAI, or LLMs. Demonstrates deep understanding and clearly justifies suitability using relevant academic literature. Shows critical engagement with theory.

value.title: Workflow and Methodology
value.hd_requirement: Presents a clear, logical, and well-structured workflow. Thoroughly explains data preprocessing, feature engineering if applicable, model design, and algorithmic approach. Demonstrates effective integration of multiple AI paradigms. Clearly distinguishes design decisions from implementation.

value.title: Empirical Analysis and Results
value.hd_requirement: Presents comprehensive experiments with a well-defined setup, datasets, and parameters, with insightful empirical analysis demonstrating solution effectiveness and supported by ethical considerations where relevant. Uses appropriate evaluation metrics such as accuracy, memory usage, or runtime. Results are clearly presented using tables or figures and interpreted insightfully. Demonstrates strong evidence of effectiveness and includes reproducibility via a well-documented GitHub repository.

value.title: Critical Reflection
value.hd_requirement: Provides deep and critical evaluation of limitations, failure cases, and trade-offs such as accuracy versus efficiency. Analyses scalability and computational constraints. Thoughtfully discusses when alternative approaches may be more suitable.

value.title: Conclusion, Future Work and References
value.hd_requirement: Provides a clear, concise, and insightful conclusion that effectively links results to project objectives and highlights key AI-related findings. Demonstrates strong critical understanding by proposing realistic, technically sound, and well-justified future work such as addressing limitations, improving scalability, or exploring alternative AI methods. Uses high-quality, relevant academic references that are consistent and well integrated into the report.

value.title: Individual Contribution
value.hd_requirement: Clearly documents specific, substantial, and verifiable contributions of each member. Demonstrates balanced and active participation.

value.title: Content and Relevance
value.hd_requirement: Presents a highly relevant real-world problem and AI solution, demonstrates clear integration of AI techniques and strong alignment between problem and chosen methods, clearly articulates significance, impact, and ethical considerations, and stays within the 7-minute limit.

value.title: AI Method Explanation and Justification
value.hd_requirement: Clearly and concisely explains the AI-based method, demonstrates deep understanding, provides strong justification for method selection, compares with alternative approaches, explains trade-offs, and shows excellent alignment between the chosen method and the problem.

value.title: Findings, Contributions, and Limitations
value.hd_requirement: Insightful findings and contributions with clear empirical results, showing solution effectiveness and innovation. Limitations are critically analysed with ethical implications.

value.title: Presentation Delivery and Interaction
value.hd_requirement: Delivers an engaging, confident, and well-paced presentation with excellent use of visuals, clear articulation, and strong audience interaction. Responds to questions with insightful, accurate, and confident answers, demonstrates deep understanding, and addresses ethical implications effectively.
